name: curve-carousel
title: Curve Carousel
description: Cards sit on a shallow arc; the focused card is upright and in front, its neighbours tilt and recede. Arrow keys, buttons, drag and swipe move it.

meta.useWhen: 3–9 case studies or products where one at a time is the point.
meta.avoidWhen: Content people need to compare; more than 9 items; as autoplaying decoration.
